svg.title: Generated prototype Azure isolation architecture
svg.desc: Azure architecture diagram showing shared corporate Entra authentication plus a dedicated API Management service, managed identity, private VNet and Container Apps backend, Foundry Agent Service agents, Container Registry, governance evidence, and Azure Monitor for each generated prototype.

text.tspan: One independently secured Azure runtime boundary per prototype
Azure subscription / dedicated prototype resource group
Gateway, network, runtime, identity, and data delete as one owned boundary
Shared workforce sign-in; prototype workload identity
Public APIM edge; private FastAPI network
SPA redirect URI + exact CORS origin
Entra validation + exact CORS + rate limit
Generated FastAPI has internal ingress only
